delete_candidate.meaning: candidate for removal or secure redaction after human approval

superseded.meaning: old plan retained only as completed/historical context

homes.apps/arda-hud: ARDA HUD control-surface implementation docs and runtime-facing app contracts.
homes.core/projects/Plans: Sovereign quick-reference project plans tied to active project execution.
homes.core/projects/tasks/queue.jsonl: Authoritative execution ledger for task pivots and live work.
homes.core/state: Machine-readable current-state snapshots and activation maps.
homes.data/athena: ATHENA ingest, digest, crawl, and research runtime data.
homes.data/mnemosyne: MNEMOSYNE operational memory, continuity markers, and recall indexes.
homes.docs: Stable explanatory architecture, governance, integration, and operations documentation.
homes.humadocs/plans/Notes: Raw human scratch notes. Distill before promotion.
homes.humadocs/plans/library: External/predecessor corpus indexes. Archive/reference only unless promoted.
homes.docs/plans: Readable operator plan shelf and curated promotion batches. Not execution truth.

rules.rule: Append task pivots and completions; do not bury execution truth in prose docs.
Keep operator-facing strategy here; link machine state instead of duplicating it.
Keep concise active status and implementation record per project/agent.
Promote durable decisions here after plans stabilize.
ATHENA owns digest/crawl receipts and classified research artifacts.
MNEMOSYNE owns continuity and significance-weighted recall surfaces.
Machines read current state here; docs should link rather than fork.
ARDA owns UX contracts and state-display shell for real system posture.
Treat as quarantine/intake, distill useful conclusions, then archive/delete.
